newsitem.title: CANADA: JetForm buys Delrina forms business from Symantec.
newsitem.headline: JetForm buys Delrina forms business from Symantec.

text.p: JetForm Corp. said on Tuesday it agreed to acquire Delrina Group's electronic forms business from software company Symantec Corp. for about $100 million.
JetForm, a major worldwide provider of products that design, fill, route, print and manage forms, said the business has a net present value of about $65 million.

The deal would give JetForm immediate full ownership and rights to all of Delrina's electronic forms-related products and technology. Delrina is recognised as a world leader in personal computer fax software, it said.
Ottawa-based JetForm said it also acquired 65 people from Delrina, more than half of whom were involved in research and development activities in Toronto.
JetForm said payment will be made quarterly in cash or stock at JetForm's option over the next four years.
Delrina was acquired by Cupertino, Calif.-based Symantec in 1995.
JetForm's stock did not trade Tuesday after closing at $24 on Nasdaq on Monday. Symantec rose 37.5 cents to $9.75 on Nasdaq.
